scope: Independent review of the frozen ordinary synchronous defer profile in ZIL-LANG-1.4 section 7.1; not full-language, product, async/unwind, Windows, Product whole-local slot rebinding or 236 consumer acceptance.

commands.command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/workspace/.zil-env/target-227 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 ZIL_TEST_REPORT_DIR=/tmp/review227-final01 cargo test -p zil-driver --features llvm-api --test review227_contracts --test impl227_machine --locked -- --nocapture

CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/workspace/.zil-env/target-227 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 ZIL_TEST_REPORT_DIR=/tmp/review227-final02 cargo test -p zil-analyze -p zil-verify --lib --locked defer_tests -- --nocapture
commands.selection: 11 must-invoke raw/Wire tests in each kernel; unrelated existing library tests intentionally not selected.

static_review: RegisterDefer binds an initialized zero-argument Unit FnOnce slot in its actual innermost activation and is adjacent to the unique initial Store.
Both kernels retain must-invoke status and mixed construction/registration age through TakeLocal; only the adjacent matching actual CallClosureOnce discharges the action.
Empty/Copy captures remain mandatory; affine Drop and slot transfers cannot settle the action.
The same-block cleanup suffix reaches the owning ScopeExit and permits only cleanup, subsequent actions, necessary capture writeback and storage teardown.
Scope/storage/return/backedge checks reconstruct actual per-activation state; an outer pending action may survive an internal loop; Trap has no unwind guarantee.

Analyze uses maps/sets and Verify independently uses action-status/owner/resource tables. Verify does not call Types/Analyze proof routines. Existing data formats and intrinsic type shapes are shared, not safety conclusions.
independent_coverage: Nested loops with skipped registration/continue/break and an outer pending action.
Managed and opaque callback return carriers are prepared before cleanup and transferred once.
Three successive FnMut calls retain deferred Copy capture mutation (1,2,3).
Borrowed callback cannot hide a resource required by future defer execution.
Empty registered action hostile raw/Wire: Drop substitute, missing call, incorrect scope, ordinary borrowing.
Actual call moved before normal body work fails cleanup suffix verification.
Real borrowed environment transferred through an ordinary FnOnce local into registered storage retains resource sources; wrong source move rejects.

Shared address Hold roots survive the same ordinary FnOnce transfer; raw/Wire reject overlapping writes. Producer exports Hold facts; ordinary shared-write exclusion remains Verify responsibility, matching the existing direct-address path.

fixed_finding.original: The outer FnMut read its Copy capture into an activation local; inner deferred mutation used an exclusive address, but no final WriteCapture was emitted. The second call saw stale state and the program exited 2.
fixed_finding.fix: The Defer capture-use walk enters nested_depth, preserving the existing indirect mutation writeback classification.
fixed_finding.provenance: Original pre-fix native failure was observed in reviewer tool output. No original cargo log was saved locally; the preserved unchanged old executable was explicitly replayed by the frontend author. These replays are not counted as new independent acceptance.

budget.checks: N succeeds; N-1 ResourceLimit; fresh N succeeds; original default limits unchanged.

rust_goals_reflection.safety: Must-invoke is explicit and independently checked; FnOnce at-most-once alone is insufficient.
rust_goals_reflection.runtime_memory: Registration is a machine no-op; existing inline closure/call/remaining-environment cleanup is reused, without hidden RC/Box/locks/tables.
rust_goals_reflection.maintenance: Source defer now expresses lexical mandatory cleanup across normal/error/loop exits; a real persistent capture bug was found and fixed.
rust_goals_reflection.compile_cost: New state and traversal work is charged; bounded logical limits tested. No total compile-time or product advantage is claimed.
rust_goals_reflection.breakthrough_status: Semantics and scope-exit implementation demonstrated only; no new quantitative product breakthrough claim.

limitations: No full workspace/product gate was run by reviewer.
238 stable whole-Product rebinding is a distinct frontend lowering obligation and is not covered by this Pass.
Final integrated 227/235/236 compiler snapshot still requires root integration checks.
